title: Partner Marketing Hub Just Got Smarter!
subject: Your Partner Marketing Hub just got smarter
body:
Hi [First Name],

The Hitachi Vantara Partner Marketing Hub has a new AI-powered experience. You can find content for your customers, personalize it for your business and launch a co-branded campaign from one place.

What’s new?

• Build campaigns faster with AI. Use AI assistance to turn a marketing goal into a campaign and spend less time planning and writing.
• Launch co-branded outreach. Activate a prebuilt campaign with your branding, or tailor its content to your audience.
• Use the tools you already have. Connect Marketo, HubSpot or Mailchimp to run approved email campaigns without rebuilding them.
• Focus on interested customers. Keep audiences current with Smart Lists and use lead scoring to see which prospects are engaging.
• See what works. Review campaign performance and use AI-powered insights to refine your next outreach.

Discover New Experience: https://partnermarketing.hitachivantara.com/home

Have a customer audience or campaign in mind? Reply with what you want to promote, and I’ll help you choose a campaign and plan your first outreach.

Best,
[Your Name]

Partner Marketing Team: partner.marketing.team@hitachivantara.com
